label: Village Generator
summary: A village of a builder's pack on the terrain: squares on flat land, roads that follow it, buildings facing them on levelled ground, farms with their fields, props, and walls if you want them.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.help: The relief the village stands on; the sea level when left empty.

inputs.name: area
inputs.label: Area
inputs.help: Where the village may go (over a half); the whole terrain when left empty, at most 4096 × 4096 blocks.

exposed.name: pack
exposed.label: Pack
exposed.help: The folder of the village pack: its schematics by type (house/, church/, farm/…) and its village.json.

exposed.name: houses
exposed.label: Houses
exposed.help: How many houses, 3 to 120: the village reaches as far as it needs to hold them.

exposed.name: size_bias
exposed.label: Small ↔ large
exposed.help: From small houses (−1) to large houses and manors (+1).

exposed.name: road
exposed.label: Road type
exposed.help: The blocks the roads are laid in: the pack's, dirt path, gravel, stone or planks.

exposed.name: walls
exposed.label: Walls
exposed.help: Ramparts round the village, towers at the corners and along them, gates where the main roads leave.

exposed.name: spread
exposed.label: Spread
exposed.help: From a compact hamlet (0) to a village strung out along its roads (1).

exposed.name: flat
exposed.label: Flat ground
exposed.help: How much the squares prefer flat land.

exposed.name: fields
exposed.label: Fields
exposed.help: The share of farms that keep a field of crops behind them.

exposed.name: props
exposed.label: Props
exposed.help: How many lampposts, benches, hay bales and carts: none (0) to many (1).

exposed.name: mill
exposed.label: Mill
exposed.help: Which mill: auto, a windmill, a watermill by the water, or none.

exposed.name: seed
exposed.label: Seed
exposed.help: Another seed gives another village of the same kind.

exposed.name: theme
exposed.label: Theme
exposed.help: Which theme of the pack, when it has several.

exposed.name: max_slope
exposed.label: Steepest plot
exposed.help: The most a plot's land may rise across it, in blocks.

exposed.name: margin
exposed.label: Margin
exposed.help: Blocks kept free round each building, at least.

exposed.name: width
exposed.label: Street width
exposed.help: The main roads' width in blocks; 0 keeps the pack's.
